title: emg2pose: Surface EMG and Hand Pose
description: This dataset is a NEMAR re-host and EMG-BIDS conversion of the public Meta emg2pose release, a large-scale benchmark pairing surface electromyography (sEMG) with hand pose labels. It comprises 2 kHz, 16-channel wrist sEMG recordings from 193 users across 370 hours and 29 behavioral stages, synchronized with hand pose labels captured via a 26-camera motion-capture rig, yielding approximately 80 million labeled frames. The dataset supports research on EMG-based hand pose estimation and human-computer interaction.
methods_description: Wrist surface EMG was recorded at 2 kHz across 16 channels, paired with hand pose labels derived from a 26-camera motion-capture rig using inverse kinematics. Data were converted from upstream HDF5 recordings into EMG-BIDS format as BDF files containing 16 EMG channels and 20 radian-valued joint-angle MISC channels, with BAD_IK annotations marking samples where inverse-kinematics labels were all zero.
